name: insl_air_shaft
description: Vertical air-wall instrument shaft insulated on both faces: BRCK-INSL-[AIR core]-INSL-BRCK.
why: Build-lessons 'instrument-bay wiring and hardening': a METL floor/slab is air-permeable and lets pressure transients cross an otherwise-sealed room; this shaft uses a WALL:AIR core (blocks particles, passes nothing) sandwiched in INSL so wiring/sensors can run through a hot zone without a thermal or pressure bridge.
source: save2, INSL shaft x316-324 y184-300 (BRCK-INSL-[AIR wall core]-INSL-BRCK cross-section)
